en.about_greeting: Hi! I'm Vladislav, a Unity programmer and 3D artist with 5 years of professional experience in game development. I have knowledge of Unity, C#, and Unreal Engine for creating game systems and mechanics.
en.about_journey: My professional experience includes working as a Unity programmer, focusing on AI behavior, character mechanics, legacy code optimization, and shader development. I also have experience in the full development cycle of hyper-casual projects and simulators.
en.about_details: I have knowledge in technical art, including Shader Graph, VFX Graph, 3D modeling in Blender, and game optimization. I have worked with Yandex SDK, IronSource, Admob, and have experience with Zenject and DoTween frameworks.
en.main_title: Each game is a new adventure!
en.main_description: Hello! I'm Vladislav, a game developer, and this is my website. Here you can find my works — games, 3D art, and more. Here, each game is a new adventure!

ru.about_journey: Мой профессиональный опыт включает работу в качестве Unity-программиста: поведение ИИ, механики персонажей, оптимизация legacy-кода и разработка шейдеров. Также имею опыт полного цикла разработки гиперказуальных проектов и симуляторов.

ru.main_description: Привет! Я Владислав, разработчик игр, и это мой сайт. На нём вы можете найти мои работы — игры, 3D арты и другое. Здесь каждая игра — это новое приключение!
